name: The Alliance Needs More Runecloth Bandages!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs More Runecloth Bandages!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So it is that we come to discuss pressing matters yet again adventurer. Once more I thank you for your previous efforts; it is not everyone who would give so selflessly. But there is still more work to do.
Friend, will you once more collect runecloth bandages and return them to me here?

clips.title: Progress
paras: So it is that we come to discuss pressing matters yet again, adventurer. Once more I thank you for your previous efforts; it is not everyone who would give so selflessly. But there is still more work to do.
Friend, will you once more collect runecloth bandages and return them to me here?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is a fine road we are traveling together, friend. You make an excellent working companion. Once more do I give thanks to you for your efforts on behalf of the entire Alliance. Come and talk again with me soon.
